answer: Every submission must name 3 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The ledge graph is validated at intake and the saffron frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and beacon anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Forging one identity takes 5 hours and a real hardware anchor; forging 138 takes that multiplied out, plus 46 thousand dollars of collateral sitting idle. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
